name: nibbi
description: Nibbi — a local agent companion with governed tools, reviewed skills and one responsive interface.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nibbi/contracts && npm run build -w @nibbi/daemon && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nibbi/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @nibbi/daemon && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nibbi/contracts && npm run test:unit && npm test -w @nibbi/daemon
scripts.release:app: cd "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-desktop/src-tauri/target}/release/bundle/macos" && rm -f Nibbi.app.zip && ditto -c -k --keepParent Nibbi.app Nibbi.app.zip && echo "$(pwd)/Nibbi.app.zip"
